title: Milos course pack freeze fixed
details: Fixed the Evia Course Packs controller that could trap Milos in a repeated DOM update loop and freeze the app
Evia Course Packs still includes Property Maintenance ST0171 and continues to read Evia's published course registry for future courses
Replaced the unsafe repeating UI patch with a guarded update that only runs when the More screen actually adds the course-packs control
Updated Milos verification so releases are checked against the current app version instead of an old hard-coded v2.15 value
